name: imgloupe
description: ImgLoupe previews, zooms, copies and downloads images in Google Docs, Sheets and Slides, with on-device English/Traditional Chinese OCR and whole-document ZIP export.

scripts.check-syntax: node -c dist/contentScripts/index.global.js && node -c dist/offscreen/offscreen.js && node -c dist/background/index.mjs && node -c dist/popup/popup.js
scripts.build:zip: npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
